mapper.select: select tenant_id, whatsapp_enabled, messenger_enabled, wechat_mp_enabled, webchat_enabled, wecom_kf_enabled, updated_by, updated_at from crm_inbox_channel_settings where tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_inbox_channel_settings ( tenant_id, whatsapp_enabled, messenger_enabled, wechat_mp_enabled, webchat_enabled, wecom_kf_enabled, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, CASE WHEN #{whatsappEnabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{messengerEnabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{wechatMpEnabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{webchatEnabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{wecomKfEnabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET whatsapp_enabled = EXCLUDED.whatsapp_enabled, messenger_enabled = EXCLUDED.messenger_enabled, wechat_mp_enabled = EXCLUDED.wechat_mp_enabled, webchat_enabled = EXCLUDED.webchat_enabled, wecom_kf_enabled = EXCLUDED.wecom_kf_enabled, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
